verdict.rationale: Requesty documents a first-party EU routing option that keeps all Requesty processing and storage in Frankfurt (AWS eu-central-1), so users can choose EU residency. The evidence covers only that one alternative region and does not explain how the region is selected or whether upstream model providers also keep data in-region. missing for 10: regions beyond the EU option, documentation of how region selection is configured, residency guarantees for downstream provider processing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Route your AI traffic through Requesty's EU infrastructure in Frankfurt, Germany (AWS eu-central-1). All processing and storage by Requesty stays in the EU.
